title: Price Increase
description: We are increasing our monthly subscription price by 20%, from $10/month to $12/month. The additional revenue will be invested in new features and faster servers.

title: Removing Free Tier
description: We are removing the free tier from our platform. All users will need to subscribe to a paid plan starting at $5/month. Existing free users will get a 30-day grace period.

title: Dark Mode Launch
description: We are launching a dark mode UI across the entire platform. This will be the default for all users, with an option to switch back to light mode in settings.

title: AI-Powered Recommendations
description: We are introducing AI-powered personalized recommendations. The AI will analyze your usage patterns to suggest relevant content and features. All data stays on our servers.

title: Community Forum Launch
description: We are launching a community forum where users can share tips, ask questions, and connect with each other. The forum will be moderated by our team and top community members.
